name: First MTP Joint Synovitis
definition: Inflammatory irritation of the first metatarsophalangeal joint causing pain, swelling and painful dorsiflexion, due to overuse, arthritis, crystal disease or trauma.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical; radiographs, ultrasound or aspiration are used according to suspected cause.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, tendon, cartilage, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: A hot acutely swollen joint may need aspiration before anti-inflammatory treatment is assumed sufficient.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-anguli Sandhi-Shotha phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Inflammatory irritation of the first metatarsophalangeal joint causing pain, swelling and painful dorsiflexion, due to overuse, arthritis, crystal disease or trauma.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
